The Ground Truth Answer states that the US is 45 years older than Mexico using the dates of their respective declarations of independence. The Predicted Answer also uses the declaration dates (July 4, 1776 for the US and September 16, 1810 for Mexico), but arrives at an age difference of "34 years, 2 months, and 12 days," and rounds it to "roughly 34 years older." 1810 (Mexico) - 1776 (US) = 34 years.
